entries.title: Mark 11:1
segments: Now when they were approaching Jerusalem, near Bethphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives,

entries.title: Mark 11:2
segments: Jesus sent two of his disciples and told them: "Go to that village in front of you, and immediately on entering it you will find a colt tied, upon which no man has ever sat; untie him and bring him here.

entries.title: Mark 11:3
segments: And if any man asks you, 'Why are you doing that?" answer, 'The Lord has need of him, and he will immediately send him back.'"

entries.title: Mark 11:4
segments: So they went and found a colt tied outside a door, in the open street, and untied it.

entries.title: Mark 11:5
segments: And some of the bystanders began to say to them, "What are you trying to do, untying that colt?"

entries.title: Mark 11:6
segments: So they answered them just as Jesus had told them, and they let them take it.

entries.title: Mark 11:7
segments: Then they brought the colt to Jesus, and when they had thrown cloaks upon it, Jesus seated himself on it.

entries.title: Mark 11:8
segments: Then many spread their cloaks on the road, and others, soft leafy branches, which they had cut from the fields;

entries.title: Mark 11:9
segments: and those who went before him and those who came after kept shouting: @"Hosanna! Blessed be He who comes in the name of the Lord!

entries.title: Mark 11:10
segments: Blessed be the coming kingdom of our father David! Hosanna, in the highest!"@

entries.title: Mark 11:11
segments: Then he entered Jerusalem and went into the Temple, and after he had looked around at everything, as the hour was now late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.

entries.title: Mark 11:12
segments: The next day after leaving Bethany he was hungry,

entries.title: Mark 11:13
segments: and seeing a fig tree in the distance full of leaves, he came to see if he could find anything on it, and found on it nothing but leaves (for it was not the time of figs).

entries.title: Mark 11:14
segments: So, addressing the tree, he said, "Let no man ever more eat fruit from you." And the disciples heard it.

entries.title: Mark 11:15
segments: Presently they reached Jerusalem, and, after entering the Temple courts, Jesus began to drive out those who were buying and selling there, and to upset the tables of the money-changers, and the stalls of those who sold doves,

entries.title: Mark 11:16
segments: and he would not allow any one to carry a vessel through the Temple courts. Then he began to teach.

entries.title: Mark 11:17
segments: "Is it not written," he said, @"My house shall be called a house of prayer for all the nations? But you have made it a den of robbers."@

entries.title: Mark 11:18
segments: The chief priests and the Scribes heard this, and they began to seek means of destroying him; for they were afraid of him because all the crowd were greatly struck with his teaching.

entries.title: Mark 11:19
segments: Now every evening he used to go outside the city;

entries.title: Mark 11:20
segments: and as they (he and his disciples) were passing along in the morning, they saw the fig tree already withered from the root.

entries.title: Mark 11:21
segments: Then Peter remembered, and exclaimed, "Look, Rabbi, the fig tree which you cursed is withered up."

entries.title: Mark 11:22
segments: "Take hold on God's faithfulness," said Jesus to them in reply.

entries.title: Mark 11:23
segments: "In solemn truth I tell you that if any one shall say to this mountain, 'Up and hurl yourself into the sea!' and shall not doubt in his heart, but on the contrary shall believe that what he says will happen, it will be granted him.

entries.title: Mark 11:24
segments: That is why I am telling you that whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it shall be yours.

entries.title: Mark 11:25
segments: And whenever you stand up to pray, forgive, if you have anything against any one, that so your Father also who is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses."

entries.title: Mark 11:27
segments: Once more they came into Jerusalem; and as he was walking in the Temple courts, there came to him the high priests and Scribes and elders and asked him:

entries.title: Mark 11:28
segments: "By what authority do you do these things? or who gave you this authority to do these things?"

entries.title: Mark 11:29
segments: "And I will put one question to you," replied Jesus. "Answer this, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

entries.title: Mark 11:30
segments: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me!"

entries.title: Mark 11:31
segments: Then they began arguing with one another: "If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask, 'Why then did you not believe him?"

entries.title: Mark 11:32
segments: On the other hand, if we say, 'From men'!" They were afraid, however, of the people, for every one held that John had been really a prophet.

entries.title: Mark 11:33
segments: So their answer to Jesus was, "We do not know." "Neither will I tell you," said Jesus, "by what authority I do these things."
